description: This file contains a test script for Git merge operations, specifically testing octopus merge scenarios, conflict resolution, and merge behaviors on different branches and tags within a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands and checking for successful completion.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with staged changes.

methods.name: git tag
methods.description: Creates a new tag at the current commit.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets the current HEAD to a specified state.

methods.name: git merge
methods.description: Merges specified branches into the current branch.

methods.name: git pull
methods.description: Fetches from and integrates with another repository or a local branch.

methods.name: git show
methods.description: Displays information about a Git object (commit, tag, etc.).

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a specific path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.
